messages:
Ada: Heads-up: telemetry reprocess run-20260320-08 is making the console lag and eating tenant reprocess quotas. Dashboards timing out in EU region. Can we mitigate without losing progress?
Jon: Which job? I see run-20260320-08 noted as windowed-recompute 1h slices, concurrency=12. That concurrency is probably too high for EU spot pool.
Priya: The problem came after an object-store transient; we retried many slices concurrently and retried writes, which pushed token burn through the roof. Console shows no live burn metric so ops couldn't triage quickly.
InfraBot: Alert: run-20260320-08 triggered auto-retries. Error spike: s3 500 -> 503. Retries=348.
Ada: Immediate ask: (1) can we throttle the job (lower concurrency) or reroute remaining work to best-effort? (2) can we add a one-click pause + reroute in the console?
Jon: For (1) we can hit POST /runs/{id}/update with {"concurrency":2,"lane":"best-effort"}. It will slow completion but reduce tail impact. For (2) console change needs a small API surface but we can add a /runs/{id}/pause-and-reroute helper.
Priya: Short-term: please pause instead of kill so already-processed slices are kept. We'll resubmit split slices (5m) to best-effort. Also we should add `dedupe_window=45s` to reduce duplicate writes.
OpsRunner: Pausing now. run-20260320-08 status=paused. Freeing transient quota locks.
Ada: Next steps: Jon to implement reroute helper and a `preview_cost` flag that returns estimated token usage per slice. Priya to requeue split jobs with kv_prime=false for best-effort.
Jon: I'll push a small endpoint patch; note estimator parity caveatconsole and runtime use slightly different heuristics. I'll run a 1-slice canary to validate.
Priya: Canary scheduled as run-20260320-08-canary at 09:00 UTC. Will collect token_burn, write_errors, kv_miss_rate.
Ada: UX ticket: REPROC-317 "Live token burn + reroute button + preflight preview" created. Priya/Jon attach canary results and link PR.
Priya: Also proposing a server-side soft-circuit: abort writes for any tenant if projected run spend > tenant_remaining * 1.2. Adds safety while we build per-tenant mid-run enforcement.
Jon: Agreed. I'll add the guard to the reroute helper and include a dry_run option to preview impacts.
Ada: Thanks team. Please paste results from the canary here and keep this thread as the single timeline.
Priya: Will do.
OpsRunner: Done for now 44b
